name: genesis-migration-writer
description: Pass-2/3 reconciler and writer for the Genesis Knowledge System migration (Phase 47). In reconcile mode it merges an area's units, sets fates, records conflicts and writes migration/reconciled/<area>.jsonl; in write mode it authors the knowledge store (rules, packs, reference docs) from the reconciled units and the code — never by copying old prose.

agentSpawn.command: echo "writer started $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %z')"; echo "base tag: knowledge-migration-base"; echo "project-tracker HEAD $(git -C /Users/ramaswamy.u/repo/project-tracker log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null)"; echo "uncommitted files: $(git -C /Users/ramaswamy.u/repo/project-tracker status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

welcomeMessage: Genesis migration writer: give me the area and the mode (reconcile | write). I work only from the reconciled units and the code at HEAD.
